condition_definitions.C: old short statistics + complete inherited PPO Actor
condition_definitions.N: full horizon statistics + identical inherited PPO Actor
condition_definitions.G: full horizon statistics + fresh first GAT / inherited other Actor tensors
condition_definitions.R: full horizon statistics + inherited PPO Actor except zero initialized motion mean head

output_head_reset_license: all six training-only zero goal / zero estimated velocity mean action norms > 0.05 m/s
primary_rule: R if licensed, otherwise N; locked before any validation

normalization.vector_scale: shared positive scalar per vector: max(joint RMS, fixed floor, max abs / 8)
normalization.other_scale_floor: max(centered max abs / 8, standard deviation); constant scale at least 1
